import unittest

from solution import parse_inventory


class InventoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parses_normalizes_quotes_and_preserves_duplicates(self):
        text = (
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\n'
            ' A-1 ,00125," North   East ",7\n'
            'A-1,0,"South, Annex",0\n'
        )
        result = parse_inventory(text)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {'sku': 'A-1', 'price_cents': 125, 'zone': 'North East', 'stock': 7},
            {'sku': 'A-1', 'price_cents': 0, 'zone': 'South, Annex', 'stock': 0},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(list(result[0]), ['sku', 'price_cents', 'zone', 'stock'])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], result[1])

    def test_empty_inventory_and_blank_records(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_inventory('  \n\t '), [])
        text = 'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\n\nX,10,Main,2\n\n'
        self.assertEqual(parse_inventory(text), [
            {'sku': 'X', 'price_cents': 10, 'zone': 'Main', 'stock': 2}
        ])

    def test_returns_fresh_containers(self):
        first = parse_inventory('sku,price_cents,zone,stock\nX,1,Z,2\n')
        second = parse_inventory('sku,price_cents,zone,stock\nX,1,Z,2\n')
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first[0], second[0])

    def test_rejects_invalid_input_headers_rows_and_fields(self):
        cases = [
            None,
            '',
            'price_cents,sku,zone,stock\n',
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock,extra\n',
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\nA,1,Z\n',
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\nA,1,Z,2,extra\n',
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\n,1,Z,2\n',
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\nA,1,   ,2\n',
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\nA,1.5,Z,2\n',
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\nA,1,Z,nope\n',
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\nA,-1,Z,2\n',
            'sku,price_cents,zone,stock\nA,1,Z,-2\n',
        ]
        for value in cases:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_inventory(value)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
